status_model.definition_status: defined means the case specification exists; it is not an execution result.
status_model.rule: Component cases cannot be marked pass/fail in the catalog; only run evidence may report an executed outcome.

invariant_id_convention: RI-SS.NN maps section SS and numbered clause NN in RUNTIME_INVARIANTS.md; section 9 required-probes paragraph is RI-09.01.

package_checks.purpose: Verify every normative Image requirement and runtime invariant is linked to executable case definitions with honest status metadata.
package_checks.setup: Parse TRACEABILITY.md, case_catalog.json, and RUNTIME_INVARIANTS.md; compare the explicit requirement/invariant coverage maps with case declarations.
package_checks.expected: Every IV requirement and RI clause has one or more existing case IDs; only the package checker reports its own execution, never a component-case pass.

package_checks.expected: No Cortex changes or Image component/native/codec/decoder source additions; the only audited dependency closure is the standalone standard-library package checker.

package_checks.expected: Evidence is structurally valid and honest; outcomes remain in the run artifact and catalog cases are not marked pass/fail.

package_checks.purpose: Validate the bounded Phase 6 forward-difference run artifact against its versioned contract, proposal-only profile, exact catalog bindings, source hashes and phase boundary.

package_checks.expected: All 13 P6 tests pass in normal and ASan/UBSan builds; only the candidate engineering operator is implemented, runtime profile stays disabled, and Phase 7 is not started.
